content.text: {"score":0.72,"reason":"The summary correctly identifies the red-to-blue color change of the small rectangle at the right transition point (between frames 1 and 2), the navy background, the static camera, and the geometric composition. However, there are several issues: (1) Continuity is marked 'intact' when the reference requires 'broken' due to the red-to-blue color change — this is a significant factual mismatch. (2) The tone tag 'detached' is included when the reference has none; while interpretive, it's an addition not grounded in pixels. (3) 'red' is listed in color_tags but 'blue' is not, though the subject describes the blue rectangle in the summary and evidence — this is a minor inconsistency. (4) 'stillness' is listed as a motion tag; the reference has no motion tags, but the rubric notes stillness is supported by fixed geometry, so this is acceptable. (5) 'wide_master' camera tag from reference is missing. The continuity status error is the most critical mismatch, as it directly contradicts the observable color change between frames."}
